caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed pewter pitcher or coffee pot, rendered in shades of gray graphite on a light, slightly yellowed background. The vessel features a tall, cylindrical body with a flared base highlighted by subtle horizontal grooves, and a domed, tiered lid topped with a knob-like finial. The handle is large, ornate, and sweeping, positioned on the left side, with a pronounced curve and small decorative flourishes near its base and top. On the right side, the spout projects outward and upward, broad at its base and narrowing to a fine point. The entire object is shaded to convey metallic texture, volume, and subtle light reflection. The borders of the drawing are defined by a thin rectangular outline, and there is a faint signature reading “Charles Cullen” at the bottom right inside this outline. An area of discoloration or a stain appears near the left edge of the paper outside the main composition.
title: Pewter Flagon
